name: Aceware
description: Input buffer for Geometry Dash. Your click waits for the first tick it survives instead of killing you.

stage.name: Stage
stage.description: How far ahead a click can be saved. Off is raw input; each stage is a wider window. F6 cycles.

remove-click-key.name: Remove Click Key
remove-click-key.description: Removes the last kept click you passed.

pause-button.name: Pause Menu Button
pause-button.description: Shows the round green Aceware button in the pause menu.

window-size.name: Window Size
window-size.description: Size of the Aceware window. You can also drag its corner in game.

prediction-check.name: Prediction Check
prediction-check.description: Checks predictions against what really happens. Costs almost nothing.

online-count.name: Show Online Users
online-count.description: Aceware has no server and makes no network requests. This setting does nothing.
